svg.title: A nurse is preparing to palpate a client's abdomen. Which of the following actions should the nurse take?
svg.desc: Warm hands, a relaxed position, light palpation before deep, and watching the client's expression all produce accurate findings without causing harm. A pulsating midline mass may be an aneurysm, and deep palpation of it can cause rupture, so this is the one action that must never be taken.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Palpation
Read the situation
A nurse is preparing to palpate a client's
abdomen. Which of the following actions
should the nurse take?
What fits here
Warm the hands before touching the client
· Ask the client to bend the knees
slightly to relax the abdominal muscles ·
Begin with light palpation before deep
palpation · Watch the client's…
Why it fits
Warm hands, a relaxed position, light
palpation before deep, and watching the
client's expression all produce accurate
findings without causing harm. A pulsating
midline mass may be an aneurysm, and deep
palpation of it can cause rupture, so this
is the one action that must never be
taken.
